title: Construct a joint native odd-E8 cross-cube primitive (no new κ)
body:
The odd-E8 construction in #5439 leaves a native producer for `H=F_block-F3` open. This PR supplies an exact joint native primitive for **one directed cross-cube block**: 512 source inputs and 512 arbitrary old reader inputs. It is a constructive component, with **no new κ or complete supplier claim**.

The polarized 64-channel factorization has four common orthogonal eight-space pairs, each with 16 channels and 128 source/reader fields. The emitted 25D word establishes the actual common charts, performs the exact dyadic reads and returns one zero-owned scratch. It does not retain a 408-helper bank for each channel.

The precise interface is:

```
source: Phi_[q_s] x_s -> R25 x_s
reader: y_r -> Phi_(q_r^perp)(y_r + sum_s H_ab[r,s] x_s)
owned C0: zero@ground -> zero@ground
paid: {7:512, 8:512, 16:512, 17:512}
```

Source line services are supplied by the entry contract and must be paid by the eventual caller. The mixed reader endpoints receive no autonomous Gaussian target credit. The ordinary bill includes 13,056 ADDs, four CLEAR_ZERO checks, eight zero-retags and every literal monomial wrapper.

- [Physical proof and all-width phase argument](https://github.com/thu-nmrc/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c9875dccd281e6fe7d9b28a38f6c385141df0950/research/odd-e8-polarized-native/PROOF.md)
- [Exact contract and paid/ordinary bill](https://github.com/thu-nmrc/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c9875dccd281e6fe7d9b28a38f6c385141df0950/research/odd-e8-polarized-native/MODULE.json)
- [Emitted factorized program](https://github.com/thu-nmrc/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c9875dccd281e6fe7d9b28a38f6c385141df0950/research/odd-e8-polarized-native/PROGRAM.json.gz)
- [Separate AI-worker review](https://github.com/thu-nmrc/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c9875dccd281e6fe7d9b28a38f6c385141df0950/research/odd-e8-polarized-native/REVIEW.md)

The source full exit has a general exact monomial phase formula for `R K_G R^-1`, so it needs no dense 2^25 state vector. Signed tableaux plus fresh absolute columns verify all 512 source gauges and 512 reader gauges; the high-rank exit uses the written universal anchor proof. These are exact one-copy operator identities that tensor-lift with their absolute phases, rather than width-one matrix-sum extrapolations. Three actual interpreter controls reject a changed global phase, the wrong physical chart and a missing uncompute.

The package also explicitly embeds the restricted 1,024-label geometry in standard dimension20 and proves 20 minimal, checking all 1,048,576 ordered Gram pairs. This is a geometry result; the emitted native program remains 25D. No free 20D-to25D connection is assumed. The scalar four-clique code has an existing generic implementation and is not claimed as a new native producer.

Verification uses CPython 3.12.13 and the standard library:

```
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/odd-e8-polarized-native
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/odd-e8-polarized-native
```

All eight registered commands and exact 26-file committed-byte checking pass. Geometry checks cover 262,144 scalar entries and 295,936 orthogonality pairings. An independent emitted-word interpreter checks all 1,024 original columns, chart chronology and zero return; it finds intermediate coefficient l1 peaks of 1 for sources, 5 for the cache and 53/8 for readers. A separate unpatched dense audit verifies 275 small-dimensional phase fixtures; the written proof supplies arbitrary dimension.

The official export of the exact head also passes all eight commands with no Git, an empty PATH and read-only source files; all exported bytes remain unchanged. Container hashes are metadata and regenerated proof artifacts compare canonical decompressed payloads.

Remaining obligations are explicit: other H blocks, reciprocal and K/H compatible chronology, source acquisition, global termination, precision/storage/compiler costs and the complete outer invoice. Static flag containment does not make ADD ordinary. There is no claim of independent human review, formal-kernel verification, full selected cold replay or scientific admission. The selected conditional κ at canonical base 32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04 remains 0.003027288235.

The pre-submission refresh retained that exact canonical main. Bounded overlap included live open-PR titles/heads, all-state GitHub text searches for odd E8/cross-cube, and recent entries of Discussions 1166/1587; arbitrary diffs, older uninspected discussion entries and unpublished work remain outside that coverage. This is not a literature-priority claim.

Credit Ali Romman for #5439; Dugongue/#4929 and Dillon Amburgey for the rank-eight code/normalizers; Cao Yifan for the native P112 lineage; Cinna Davis, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman and the retained native, Clifford, compiler and analytic contributors. Standard polarization and Clifford identities retain their classical status. Prepared for THU New Media Research Center (@thu-nmrc) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0. This adds one opt-in package and changes no selected record, shared code or predecessor evidence.
